1.1: It was my fault. It was all my fault. If only I hadn’t distracted him back then, none of this would have happened.
1.2: I don’t care that he was something as blasphemous as a cultist.
1.3: I don’t care that he had essentially lied to me for the entirety of our relationship.
1.4: I thought I would feel betrayed. And I did, briefly. But now there’s only an all-consuming sorrow.
1.5: If only he had told me, everything would have been fine. Instead, he’s never coming back.
2.1: With each passing day, my life grows duller, more meaningless. I’ve tried to move on, but I can’t endure it anymore.
2.2: Living in a world without him is impossible.
2.3: Finding something new to live for feels just as empty.
2.4: My only option, then, is to go to him, by any means necessary.
2.5: Even if it costs me everything.
3.1: Using the ritual book that he used, I’m going to open a portal to hell. Whatever it takes, I’m going to reunite with him and bring him back to the surface.
3.2: Even if it means committing a taboo.
3.3: Even if I don’t know what awaits me below.
3.4: Even if I don’t know whether I’ll be able to return.
